mapper.select: SELECT * FROM public.nocode_application_object_follow WHERE application_id = #{app} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY object_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nocode_application_object_follow(application_id, object_id, enabled, state, lock_version, creator, updater) VALUES (#{app}, #{object}, #{enabled}, 'FOLLOWING', 1, #{actor}, #{actor}) ON CONFLICT(application_id, object_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO public.nocode_application_object_follow(application_id, object_id, enabled, state, followed_version, followed_at, lock_version, creator, updater) VALUES (#{app}, #{object}, true, 'FOLLOWING', #{version}, clock_timestamp(), 0, #{actor}, #{actor}) ON CONFLICT(application_id, object_id) DO UPDATE SET state = 'FOLLOWING', pending_version = NULL, pending_code = NULL, pending_reason = NULL, followed_version = EXCLUDED.followed_version, followed_at = clock_timestamp(), updater = #{actor}, update_time = clock_timestamp()

INSERT INTO public.nocode_application_object_follow(application_id, object_id, enabled, state, pending_version, pending_code, pending_reason, lock_version, creator, updater) VALUES (#{app}, #{object}, true, 'PENDING', #{version}, #{code}, #{reason}, 0, #{actor}, #{actor}) ON CONFLICT(application_id, object_id) DO UPDATE SET state = 'PENDING', pending_version = EXCLUDED.pending_version, pending_code = EXCLUDED.pending_code, pending_reason = EXCLUDED.pending_reason, updater = #{actor}, update_time = clock_timestamp()

INSERT INTO public.nocode_application_object_follow_log(application_id, object_id, from_version, to_version, application_version_before, application_version_after, outcome, pending_code, reason, trigger_kind, plan_id, creator, updater) VALUES (#{row.applicationId}, #{row.objectId}, #{row.fromVersion}, #{row.toVersion}, #{row.applicationVersionBefore}, #{row.applicationVersionAfter}, #{row.outcome}, #{row.pendingCode}, #{row.reason}, #{row.triggerKind}, CAST(#{row.planId} AS uuid), #{actor}, #{actor})
mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.application_id, l.object_id, l.from_version, l.to_version, l.application_version_before, l.application_version_after, l.outcome, l.pending_code, l.reason, l.trigger_kind, l.plan_id::text AS plan_id, l.creator, l.create_time, l.updater, l.update_time, l.deleted, a.app_name AS application_name FROM public.nocode_application_object_follow_log l JOIN public.nocode_application a ON a.id = l.application_id WHERE l.plan_id = CAST(#{plan} AS uuid) AND l.deleted = 0 ORDER BY l.application_id, l.id
SELECT * FROM public.nocode_application_object_follow WHERE state = 'PENDING' AND enabled = true AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.id FROM public.nocode_application a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(a.design_json -> 'objects') = 'array' THEN a.design_json -> 'objects' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) r WHERE r ->> 'objectId' = #{object}) ORDER BY a.id
